director_changes: Mr. Rajendra Manoharlal Agrawal appointed as Additional Director (Independent Director) w.e.f. 20/01/2026
Mrs. Anupama Bharat Gupta retires by rotation and offers herself for re-appointment
Mr. Anupama Bharat Gupta, Director of the Company, retired by rotation and re-appointed at the annual general meeting held on 29th September, 2025.

Mr. Rajendra Manoharlal Agrawal was appointed to the Board as an Additional Independent Director w.e.f. 20th January, 2026 for a period of five (5) years subject to the approval of shareholders at the 33rd AGM.

outlook.statement: FY 2025-26 has been a year of strong recovery in the Indian travel and tourism industry. The growth of the Company is mainly linked to the growth of the Hotel, tourism and hospitality industries.

The outlook for the sector undoubtedly looks positive. The company continues to remain focused on risk management and mitigation. An analysis of contracts shows that the initial development and construction stages involve significant risks.
